form.label: Darkmoon — Findings
form.description: All Darkmoon findings (current state). Filter by severity, status, category, campaign or target. Click a row for safe detail (no evidence is stored or shown).

search.query: `darkmoon_findings` severity="$sev$" category="$category_tok$" target="$target_tok$" campaign_id="$campaign_tok$" | dedup finding_id sortby -_time | search status="$statusf$" | stats dc(finding_id) as count by severity

`darkmoon_findings` severity="$sev$" category="$category_tok$" target="$target_tok$" campaign_id="$campaign_tok$" | dedup finding_id sortby -_time | search status="$statusf$" | stats dc(finding_id) as count by status

`darkmoon_findings` severity="$sev$" category="$category_tok$" target="$target_tok$" campaign_id="$campaign_tok$" | dedup finding_id sortby -_time | search status="$statusf$" | table _time finding_id title severity status category target endpoint cve cvss_score mitre_attack_id mitre_attack_name campaign_id discovered_by_agent has_evidence | sort - _time | rename _time as time, cvss_score as cvss, mitre_attack_id as mitre_id, mitre_attack_name as mitre

panel.title: Finding detail — $sel_finding$ (safe fields only; no evidence)

search.query: `darkmoon_findings` finding_id="$sel_finding$" | dedup finding_id sortby -_time | eval discovered=strftime(_time,"%F %T") | table finding_id title severity status category target endpoint cve cvss_score cvss_vector mitre_attack_id mitre_attack_name iso27001_control discovered_by_agent has_evidence campaign_id project_id discovered | transpose column_name="field" | rename "row 1" as value
